alignments.note: οὔπω is one adverb spelling negation plus 'yet'; the ASV writes both words for it, discontinuous from the verb's helpers under rule 15. Head on 'not', the negative being the element the lexeme is built on; heading on 'yet' as the distinctive -πω element is defensible but the negation carries the sense.
Inflected verb takes its supplied subject 'Ye' and auxiliary 'have' as rule 9 helpers, headed on the lexical verb 'resisted'.
μέχρις rendered by the single preposition 'unto'.
Anarthrous genitive noun rendered by a bare 'blood'.
Circumstantial participle rendered by the bare participle 'striving'.
The English preposition governing the prepositional phrase realizes πρός under rule 36, not the participle it depends on.

The ASV gives 'sin' no determiner, so the article has no English 'the' to anchor and is unrepresented under rule 23; rule 21 forbids leaving a bare 'against' on it, so the case preposition stays with πρός.
